look_here_first: Opposite leaves at stem nodes; check leaf undersides for hairs, then widely spaced compact rounded flower clusters along an elongated inflorescence.

project_inclusion.notes: Texas-state-level native; three project target counties have not been independently confirmed.

taxonomy_notes: Accepted species; source infraspecific or historical synonyms are not separate canonical cards. Do not assign variety from species-only evidence.

morphology_keys.habit: Woody, often lax limestone shrub; habit and limestone alone do not prove identity.
morphology_keys.leaves_attachment: Opposite leaves; inspect underside hair type and density with magnification, noting any glands.
morphology_keys.flower_reproductive: Elongated racemose axis with paired compact globose clusters of small tubular flowers.
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Small dry capsules; document mature fruit and capsule morphology.
morphology_keys.stem_bud: Woody stems with opposite leaf nodes; inspect flowering axis as a whole.

confused_with: Buddleja marrubiifolia: dense woolly globose heads and rounded heavily tomentose foliage
Buddleja davidii: larger dense terminal flower panicles; nonnative ornamental
comparisons.key_distinctions: Buddleja marrubiifolia: dense woolly globose heads and rounded heavily tomentose foliage; Buddleja davidii: larger dense terminal flower panicles; nonnative ornamental
